title: City: maps & the real world
body: The big one. Maps, point clouds and GPS: I take real-world data and turn it into something you can move through, like a digital twin of a street or AR that knows which corner you’re standing on. I’m still a little amazed that this works at all.

title: Room: games, apps & toys
body: The one you can hold. Games, apps, websites, buttons and sliders. This is where I get to build fast, whether it’s a tiny mobile game, a training sim or a whole UX overhaul. If it makes someone smile or learn something, I’ve done my job.

title: Chip: tools & the nerdy bits
body: The small one, and the one nobody sees. Tools, SDKs, computer vision, synthetic data, characters you can talk to and a backend that simply keeps running. It’s what makes the other two possible. Nobody claps for a backend, and that’s fine.
